column2: [title19][sentence]\nThis must be where the guards monitor\nsecurity operations.
column3: [title19][sentence]\n這裡應該就是警衛\n監控保全的地方。

column2:
[title30][sentence]
Peering into the depths of the coffee mug,
you notice what appears to be a small
bacteria colony declaring independence from
it's larger neighbor.
column3:
[title30][sentence]
盯著咖啡杯底往下看，
你發現裡面那坨小細菌，
似乎正在向隔壁那坨
龐然大物宣布獨立。

column2:
[title26][sentence]
The doughnut is no longer edible.  It has
been sitting here for . . . well, it's probably too 
old to be carbon dated.  The glaze has
flowed down onto the newspaper forming
a permanent bond.
column3:
[title26][sentence]
這甜甜圈早就不能吃了，
放在這裡放到……嗯，
大概老到連碳定年法
都測不出來。糖霜已經
把它和報紙黏成一體。

column2:
[title30][sentence]
Hoping to find something interesting you take
a quick look at the magazine.  It does not resemble
the "Gal" magazine you used to read--everyone
is in this issue is dressed.
column3:
[title30][sentence]
你抱著看點好料的期待，
隨手翻了一下這本雜誌，
卻發現它跟你以前看的
《辣妹》雜誌完全不同——
這期裡每個人都穿得整整齊齊。

column2:
[title27][sentence]
These little footballs remind you of boarding
school.  The only field goal you scored
in your entire life was with one of these.
column3:
[title27][sentence]
這些迷你橄欖球讓你想起
寄宿學校的日子。你這輩子
唯一的一次「射門得分」，
就是靠其中一顆達成的。

column2:
[title32][sentence]
You are not sure how old this newspaper is.  Through
the doughnut stains and coffee spillage
you are able to make out the headline, which
reads: "War Of The Sexes - Women Wind Up On
Top."
column3:
[title32][sentence]
你不確定這份報紙有多舊了，
穿過甜甜圈漬痕和咖啡
漬跡，你勉強認出頭條
寫著：「性別戰爭——
女人終究『壓在上頭』。」

column2:
[title25][sentence]
The clipboard has a pencil and a strange
note on it.  From the illegibility of the
handwriting you assume the author was
engaged in medical practice.
column3:
[title25][sentence]
這塊寫字板上夾著一枝
鉛筆和一張怪字條。
看那鬼畫符般的筆跡，
你猜這八成是醫生寫的。

column2:
[title25][sentence]
In front of you are two monitors used by the
guards for security purposes.  The desk they
sit at is cluttered with junk.
column3:
[title25][sentence]
你面前有兩台螢幕，
是警衛用來監控保全的。
螢幕下的桌子堆滿雜物。

column2:
[title29][sentence]
The contents of the mug have already
rendered it incapable of being resanitized.
You decide that there are more interesting
ways to catch exotic diseases.
column3:
[title29][sentence]
這杯子裡的東西，
已經髒到沒救，
沒辦法再消毒了。
你覺得想染上什麼怪病，
應該有更有趣的辦法。

column2: [title25][sentence]\nThere isn't any blank paper left to\ndoodle on, so you decide to leave it.
column3: [title25][sentence]\n沒有空白的紙可以塗鴉了，\n你決定不拿它。

column2:
[title26][sentence]
The doughnut may yet evolve into
the cure for something, but currently
it holds no value.
column3:
[title26][sentence]
這甜甜圈說不定哪天
會演化成什麼特效藥，
但現在它一點用也沒有。

column2: [title20][sentence]\nYou'd just lose it.  Leave it here.
column3: [title20][sentence]\n你只會把它弄丟，\n還是留在這裡吧。

column2: [title19][sentence]\nThere are no naked pictures in it,\nso it is of no use to you.
column3: [title19][sentence]\n裡面沒有裸體照片，\n對你來說沒什麼用。

column2:
[title22][sentence]
The newspaper is stuck to the desk
by the adhesive doughnut glaze.
column3:
[title22][sentence]
報紙已經被黏答答的
甜甜圈糖霜黏在桌上了。

column2: [title12][sentence]\nYou see a rock wall.
column3: [title12][sentence]\n你看到一面石牆。

column2:
[title29][sentence]
The keypad has twelve keys on it.
The numerals zero through nine are
present, as well as 'smile' and 'frown'
keys.
column3:
[title29][sentence]
這個鍵盤上有十二個按鍵，
除了數字0到9之外，
還多了『笑臉』和
『哭臉』兩個鍵。

column2:
[title29][sentence]
This is entry device is about
as complicated as a pocket
calculator.  Take your time;
you'll get it eventually.
column3:
[title29][sentence]
這台輸入裝置的複雜程度，
大概跟計算機差不多。
慢慢來，你遲早
會搞懂的。

column2: [title25][sentence]\nIt's a key.  Hint: It's about the same\nsize as the tip of a human finger.
column3: [title25][sentence]\n這是一把鑰匙。提示：\n它大概只有指尖那麼大。

column2:
[title17][sentence]
You are standing in an
alien teleportation device.
column3:
[title17][sentence]
你正站在一台
外星傳送裝置裡。

column2:
[title26][sentence]
Close examination reveals that the screen
has been disabled by a small piece of
rock, which appears to have transferred
an inordinate amount of kinetic energy to the
picture tube.
column3:
[title26][sentence]
仔細一看你發現螢幕
已經報銷了——兇手是
一小塊石頭，顯然把
大量動能一股腦兒
轉移到了映像管上。

column2:
[title25][sentence]
As you examine the damage you are 
glad that you were on the good side
of that large sauropod fellow.
column3:
[title25][sentence]
看著這片狼藉，你慶幸
自己是站在那隻
蜥腳龍朋友的這一邊。

column2:
[title25][sentence]
You are amazed by the strength of the
sauropod and feel sorry for any dogs 
in the area.
column3:
[title25][sentence]
你對這隻蜥腳龍的
蠻力嘆為觀止，也替附近
可能出現的狗兒默哀。

column2: [title27][sentence]\nThis guard has apparently seen better days.
column3: [title27][sentence]\n這個警衛顯然過得不太好。

column2:
[title33][sentence]
This guard has probably looked better.  You 
gather the credit chip in her hand was used in
an attempt to buy her safety from your large
friend.  Apparently, the offer was refused.
column3:
[title33][sentence]
這個警衛顯然也不太妙。
看她手裡還握著信用晶片，
你猜她是想拿它跟你的
大個子朋友買條命——
看樣子，對方沒接受。

column2:
[title33][sentence]
This equipment has been pretty well
destroyed.  Even if you could repair
it you wouldn't know how to use it.
You would be wise to consider it "scrap".
column3:
[title33][sentence]
這台設備已經徹底報銷了。
就算修得好，你也不會用。
還是死心，
當它是一堆「廢鐵」吧。

column2: [title19][sentence]\nThe desk, along with everything around\nit, has been demolished.
column3: [title19][sentence]\n這張桌子連同周圍的一切，\n全都被砸爛了。

column2:
[title20][sentence]
The machine serves as this poor
guard's head rest.  In its current condition,
it is capable of little else.
column3:
[title20][sentence]
這台機器現在的功能，
只剩下讓這可憐的警衛
枕著頭而已。

column2: [title20][sentence]\nThis gadget looks familiar to you.
column3: [title20][sentence]\n這個小玩意你看著眼熟。

column2: [title27][sentence]\nIt's blinking!  That means it probably works.\nToo bad it's operation is a complete mystery to you.
column3:
[title27][sentence]
它在閃燈！表示大概還能用。
可惜你完全不知道
該怎麼操作它。

column2: [title20][sentence]\nThrough the door is the security area\nyou just came from.
column3: [title20][sentence]\n穿過這扇門，就是你\n剛剛離開的保全區。

column2:
[title26][sentence]
The room has been devastated, with things
thrown and smashed everywhere.
The place certainly has changed since you
were here last.  What a mess!
column3:
[title26][sentence]
這個房間被砸得亂七八糟，
東西丟得到處都是。
跟你上次來的時候
完全不一樣了。真是一團亂！

column2:
[title20][sentence]
The pole obviously serves some important
structural purpose, the exact nature of which
is beyond your architectural expertise.
column3:
[title20][sentence]
這根柱子顯然有什麼
重要的結構功能，
但確切原理已經超出
你的建築知識範圍。

column2: [title25][sentence]\nWell, don't just stand there.\nGo around it.
column3: [title25][sentence]\n別傻站在這裡了，\n繞過去吧。

column2:
[title24][sentence]
The large pipes must carry something
somewhere.  None of them have been
damaged.
column3:
[title24][sentence]
這些粗水管一定是在
輸送什麼東西。
它們都完好無損。

column2:
[title21][sentence]
The broken beam must have helped
support part of the ceiling.  You don't
want to be standing here if it
gives way.
column3:
[title21][sentence]
這根斷掉的樑柱原本
應該是撐著部分天花板的。
萬一它整個垮下來，
你可不想站在這裡。

column2: [title18][sentence]\nTo the north you see another\nroom through the doorway.
column3: [title18][sentence]\n往北透過門口，你\n可以看到另一個房間。

column2: [title19][sentence]\nThe corridor leads south toward a four-way\nintersection.
column3: [title19][sentence]\n這條走廊往南通往\n一個十字路口。

column2:
[title25][sentence]
Your friend has obviously been here.
The hallway is in sad shape.  There
are no guards here, living or otherwise.
column3:
[title25][sentence]
你朋友顯然來過這裡，
走廊被弄得慘不忍睹。
這裡沒有警衛，活的死的都沒有。

column2:
[title25][sentence]
The floor is covered with debris
from the walls, including a couple
large chunks of rock.
column3:
[title25][sentence]
地板上滿是牆壁
崩落的碎片，
還有幾塊大石塊。

column2: [title20][sentence]\nThe ceiling is covered with pipes.
column3: [title20][sentence]\n天花板上佈滿了水管。

column2:
[title26][sentence]
The walls here were obviously carved
from the native rock.  They would be
interesting only to a geologist.
column3:
[title26][sentence]
這裡的牆壁顯然是從
原生岩石鑿出來的，
大概只有地質學家
會覺得有趣。

column2:
[title33][sentence]
These controls run the hallway sensor arrays,
which detect such things as temperature, humidity,
and shoe and blouse clashes.
column3:
[title33][sentence]
這些控制項負責操作走廊
感測陣列，偵測溫度、
濕度，還有鞋子跟上衣
「撞色」之類的東西。

column2:
[title25][sentence]
This must be a busy intersection.  The
signal is not currently operating, so you
assume this is an off-peak hour.
column3:
[title25][sentence]
這應該是個繁忙的路口。
號誌現在沒在運作，
你猜這是離峰時段。

column2:
[title27][sentence]
These catwalks look like they
might be used for maintenance
purposes.  They are well out
of your reach.
column3:
[title27][sentence]
這些天橋看起來
是給維修人員用的。
它們的位置
你根本搆不到。

column2:
[title21][sentence]
You don't remember this duct being
connected to the air shafts you crawled
through.  It must be a return vent.
column3:
[title21][sentence]
你不記得這根管道
跟你爬過的通風井
有連在一起，應該是回風口。

column2:
[title24][sentence]
You are standing at the intersection
of two hallways.  You notice a dead
guard sitting under a devastated wall.
column3:
[title24][sentence]
你站在兩條走廊的
交叉口，注意到一具
警衛的屍體，癱坐在
倒塌的牆邊。

column2:
[title26][sentence]
This corridor to the north appears
to have suffered the same fate as
this corridor.
column3:
[title26][sentence]
北邊這條走廊看起來
遭遇了跟這條
一樣的下場。

column2:
[title25][sentence]
The corridor to the south has not
been significantly damaged.  You
see an odd device down that way.
column3:
[title25][sentence]
南邊的走廊沒有
受到太大的損害，
你看到那邊有個奇怪的裝置。

column2: [title25][sentence]\nThe corridor to the detention area has\nbeen severely damaged by your friend.
column3: [title25][sentence]\n通往拘留區的走廊，\n被你朋友嚴重破壞了。

column2:
[title30][sentence]
The corridor to the west has not been
damaged.  Your friend must not have
gone that way.
column3:
[title30][sentence]
西邊的走廊沒有受損，
你朋友一定沒有
往那個方向去。

column2:
[title25][sentence]
Something hit the walls here pretty
hard.  There are piles of debris
everywhere.
column3:
[title25][sentence]
有東西狠狠撞過
這裡的牆壁，
到處都是碎石堆。

column2:
[title29][sentence]
This guard has not had a fun day.
Her rifle has been broken in half,
her legs look broken, and worst
of all, her hair is messed up.
column3:
[title29][sentence]
這個警衛今天過得
很不順。她的步槍
斷成兩截，腿看起來
也斷了，最慘的是——
頭髮還亂了。

column2:
[title21][sentence]
This is the air vent you jimmied, then escaped
through.  You don't need to worry about it any more
now that the cell block has been demolished.
column3:
[title21][sentence]
這就是你當初撬開
逃出去的那個通風口。
牢房區都被拆了，
你不用再擔心它了。

column2: [title22][sentence]\nYou don't need to do that.  You now\nhave free run of the detention area.
column3: [title22][sentence]\n不需要這麼做了，\n你現在可以自由進出拘留區。

column2: [title27][sentence]\nLooking again at this awful bed you are\nglad you aren't going to have to sleep in it.
column3: [title27][sentence]\n再看一眼這張爛床，\n你慶幸自己不用睡這裡了。

column2:
[title33][sentence]
Egad!  Look at all the stringy hair
clumped together in the drain.  It's 
just like your sink, except that there
isn't anything crawling around in it.
column3:
[title33][sentence]
我的天！排水孔裡
卡著一坨一坨的頭髮，
跟你家水槽一樣——
只差沒有東西在裡面爬。

column2:
[title26][sentence]
Noticing that the seat is down you
quickly conclude that the last prisoner
must have been female.  You are
momentarily stunned by your own
brilliance.
column3:
[title26][sentence]
看到馬桶蓋是放下來的，
你立刻推論出上一個
囚犯一定是女的。
你被自己的
聰明才智震懾了一下。

column2:
[title25][sentence]
Your cell has changed a bit since
you were last here.  You pal seems
to have redecorated a bit.
column3:
[title25][sentence]
你的牢房自從你
離開後變了不少，
你哥兒們似乎重新裝潢過了。

column2:
[title25][sentence]
The back wall of this cell was obviously
carved from solid rock.  The other walls
are made of a strong ferrous metal.
column3:
[title25][sentence]
這間牢房的後牆
顯然是從整塊岩石
鑿出來的，其他牆則是堅固鐵金屬。

column2:
[title26][sentence]
Possibly the only thing in the room brighter
than yourself, the light bathes the room in
a sodium-orange glow.
column3:
[title26][sentence]
這盞燈大概是全場
除了你以外最亮的東西，
把房間染成一片鈉黃色。

column2: [title17][sentence]\nEven the floor wasn't safe from\nthat beast's rampage.
column3: [title17][sentence]\n就連地板也沒能\n逃過那隻怪物的暴走。

column2: [title17][sentence]\nThere are bits of wall and guard all\nover the place.
column3: [title17][sentence]\n到處都是牆壁\n跟警衛的碎塊。

column2:
[title29][sentence]
Talk about useless stuff.  You
briefly consider taking some of
the debris, then come to your
senses and decide to move on.
column3:
[title29][sentence]
說到沒用的東西……
你一度考慮撿點
瓦礫走，但很快
恢復理智，決定放棄。

column2:
[title29][sentence]
The corridor walls have suffered
some damage at the hands of your
large friend.  There are occasional
pieces of guard splattered against
the walls to the west of you.
column3:
[title29][sentence]
走廊的牆壁在你這位
大個子朋友手下
受了點損傷。
西邊的牆上，
偶爾還噴著幾片警衛的碎肉。

column2:
[title27][sentence]
This leads to the medical examination
room.  There doesn't appear to be
anyone in there.
column3:
[title27][sentence]
這裡通往醫療檢查室，
裡面似乎
沒有半個人。

column2:
[title30][sentence]
Down the corridor you see much of the
same kind of damage you see here.  There
are remnants of guards all over the place.
column3:
[title30][sentence]
順著走廊看過去，
損壞情況跟這裡
差不多，到處都是警衛的殘骸。

column2: [title26][sentence]\nYou don't see anyone in that direction,\nbut the corridor looks badly damaged.
column3: [title26][sentence]\n那個方向看不到人，\n但走廊損壞得很嚴重。

column2: [title22][sentence]\nThere's no one there.  The corridor\nhas been mostly demolished.
column3: [title22][sentence]\n那裡沒有人，\n走廊幾乎全毀了。

column2: [title22][sentence]\nYou can't imagine your friend being\nable to lie down on this tiny thing.
column3: [title22][sentence]\n你實在無法想像\n你朋友怎麼躺得下這麼小的床。

column2:
[title25][sentence]
The sink is relatively clean except
for some crusty dried-up monster 
saliva.
column3:
[title25][sentence]
水槽算是滿乾淨的，
只有一些乾掉結痂的
怪物口水。

column2:
[title27][sentence]
It's empty.  Maybe your friend
got thirsty?  You decide not to be
judgmental as you remember
some of the things you've poured
down your throat.
column3:
[title27][sentence]
是空的。也許你朋友
口渴了？你決定不予置評——
畢竟想想自己以前
灌下肚的那些東西，
你也沒資格說別人。

column2: [title16][sentence]\nThis cell looks remarkably like\nthe one you were in.
column3: [title16][sentence]\n這間牢房看起來\n跟你之前那間很像。

column2:
[title25][sentence]
The corridor here is as devastated
as everything else that came
between your friend and the
teleporter he used to escape.
column3:
[title25][sentence]
這裡的走廊跟你朋友
逃跑路上經過的
所有地方一樣，
被破壞得一乾二淨。

column2:
[title27][sentence]
The latch on this air vent hasn't
corroded at all.  This would be
difficult to open from the
other side.  Fortunately you
don't need to worry about crawling
around in air ducts any more.
column3:
[title27][sentence]
這個通風口的門閂
完全沒有生鏽，
從另一邊要打開
會很困難。幸好你
再也不用擔心
要爬通風管了。

column2:
[title30][sentence]
As you look at the heavily stained walls
you are almost religiously thankful that
the large fellow was your friend.  There
are two distinct shades of stain in the cell.
You suppose that the monster and his last
meal are both represented here.
column3:
[title30][sentence]
看著這滿是污漬的牆壁，
你幾乎要感謝上天，
讓這個大傢伙是你朋友。
牢房裡有兩種顏色的污漬，
你猜這隻怪物
跟牠的最後一餐都在這裡了。

column2: [title19][sentence]\nThis bed looks like it has been used for\na dining table.
column3: [title19][sentence]\n這張床看起來\n被拿來當餐桌用了。

column2:
[title25][sentence]
There are many unrecognizable chunks
in the sink.  For the sake of your stomach
you decide to stare elsewhere.
column3:
[title25][sentence]
水槽裡有很多
認不出來的碎塊，
為了你的胃，還是別看比較好。

column2:
[title25][sentence]
Clean!  This monster that lived here
must have had some other way of
dealing with waste.
column3:
[title25][sentence]
很乾淨！住在這裡的怪物
處理排泄物的方式，
顯然跟一般不太一樣。

column2:
[title19][sentence]
Wow!  Your friend sure lived up to his
promise.  The beast that inhabited this
cell looks like it had an unexpected
encounter with a wood chipper.
There are pieces of monster all over the
place.  You notice some sort of card on
the floor amidst the stains.
column3:
[title19][sentence]
哇！你朋友真的說到做到。
住在這間牢房的怪物，
看起來像是不小心
撞上了碎木機。
怪物的碎塊灑得到處都是。
你注意到血漬中
有張卡片之類的東西。

column2:
[title20][sentence]
Wow!  Your friend sure lived up to his
promise.  The beast that inhabited this
cell looks like it had an unexpected
encounter with a wood chipper.
There are pieces of monster all over the
place.
column3:
[title20][sentence]
哇！你朋友真的說到做到。
住在這間牢房的怪物，
看起來像是不小心
撞上了碎木機，
碎塊灑得到處都是。

column2: [title22][sentence]\nThe corridor to the east is trashed.\nYou don't see anyone moving.
column3: [title22][sentence]\n東邊的走廊一片狼藉，\n你沒看到任何動靜。

column2:
[title27][sentence]
You don't see any guards down that
way at the moment.  The corridor
itself is in pretty bad shape.
column3:
[title27][sentence]
那邊目前看不到
任何警衛，走廊本身
也是破爛不堪。

column2:
[title26][sentence]
This limb looks humanoid, but you
can't be sure.  What's the difference
anyway?  Parts is parts.
column3:
[title26][sentence]
這條肢體看起來像人型，
但你也說不準。
反正殘肢就是殘肢，有差嗎？

column2: [title25][sentence]\nYou have no need for this\ndisgusting limb.
column3: [title25][sentence]\n你用不著\n這條噁心的殘肢。

column2:
[title26][sentence]
You cringe as you fish the card
out of the gooey mound of bloody
monster flesh.
column3:
[title26][sentence]
你一邊皺眉一邊
把卡片從那坨黏糊糊
的血肉堆裡挖出來。

column2:
[title25][sentence]
This must have been worn by the
poor guard this beast was
snacking on.
column3:
[title25][sentence]
這應該是那個
倒楣警衛的東西——
就是被這隻怪物當點心吃掉的那個。

column2:
[title25][sentence]
There are stains everywhere.  It appears
Your large friend tore this beast into numerous little
chunks and sprayed them all over the place.
Partially imbedded in one of the mounds
on the floor is a small laminated card.
column3:
[title25][sentence]
到處都是污漬。看樣子
你的大個子朋友把這隻怪物
撕成了無數小塊，
噴得滿地都是。
地上其中一堆裡，
卡著一張小卡片。

column2:
[title26][sentence]
There are stains everywhere.  It appears
Bud tore this beast into numerous little
chunks, and sprayed him all over the place.
column3:
[title26][sentence]
到處都是污漬。看樣子
巴德把這隻怪物撕成了
無數小塊，噴得滿地都是。

column2: [title26][sentence]\nThis was obviously part of the wall before\nyour friend came through here.
column3: [title26][sentence]\n這原本顯然是牆壁的一部分，\n在你朋友經過之前。

column2: [title19][sentence]\nYou quickly decide not to carry\naround construction supplies.
column3: [title19][sentence]\n你很快就決定\n不要隨身帶著建材走。

column2: [title27][sentence]\nYour friend must have been in a destructive\nmood to have torn the floor up like that.
column3: [title27][sentence]\n你朋友那時心情\n一定很想搞破壞，才會把地板撕成這樣。

column2:
[title25][sentence]
The corridor here is in sad shape.
Pieces have been ripped from the walls;
parts of the floor have been torn up.  Your
friend definitely has a violent streak.
column3:
[title25][sentence]
這裡的走廊慘不忍睹，
牆壁被撕下一塊塊，
地板也被撕開。
你朋友絕對有暴力傾向。

column2:
[title25][sentence]
The floor is covered with red stains
and miscellaneous chunks of monster.
Partially imbedded in one little puddle
is some sort of laminated card.
column3:
[title25][sentence]
地板上滿是紅色污漬
和各種怪物碎塊。
其中一小灘裡，
卡著一張塑膠卡片。

column2:
[title25][sentence]
The floor is covered with red stains
and various-sized chunks of monster.
column3:
[title25][sentence]
地板上滿是紅色污漬，
還有大小不一的怪物碎塊。

column2: [title25][sentence]\nThe corridor to the west has been torn to pieces.\nThere are no guards in sight.
column3: [title25][sentence]\n西邊的走廊已經\n被撕得四分五裂，看不到任何警衛。

column2:
[title25][sentence]
The corridor to the east is in even worse
shape than this one.  You don't see
any movement down that way.
column3:
[title25][sentence]
東邊的走廊比這裡
更慘。你沒看到
那個方向有任何動靜。

column2: [title21][sentence]\nThis bed is clean.  It looks unused.
column3: [title21][sentence]\n這張床很乾淨，\n看起來沒人用過。

column2: [title17][sentence]\nThe sink is clean and empty.
column3: [title17][sentence]\n水槽乾淨又是空的。

column2:
[title21][sentence]
You have sudden flashbacks of
many religious experiences in close
proximity to this type of plumbing
hardware.  As reality summons you
back you note only that the toilet
is clean.
column3:
[title21][sentence]
你突然回想起許多
跟這類衛浴設備
有關的「宗教體驗」。
等你回過神來，
只注意到馬桶
是乾淨的。

column2: [title20][sentence]\nThe cell is empty and the damage\nsurrounding it is minimal.
column3: [title20][sentence]\n這間牢房是空的，\n周圍的損害也不大。

column2:
[title22][sentence]
The air vent is closed and the
latch is in good shape.  Fortunately
you won't be needing to crawl around
in there any more.
column3:
[title22][sentence]
通風口是關著的，
門閂狀況良好。
幸好你再也
不用爬進去了。

column2: [title21][sentence]\nThe corridor has been damaged by the\npassage of a certain large and angry sauropod.
column3: [title21][sentence]\n這條走廊的損壞，\n是某隻暴怒蜥腳龍經過造成的。

column2:
[title26][sentence]
The damage to the walls here is
extensive.  It's going to take a lot
of work to repair this hallway.
column3:
[title26][sentence]
這裡牆壁的損壞
相當嚴重，修好這條
走廊得花不少功夫。

column2:
[title25][sentence]
On the desk you see a pair of monitors,
some papers, and the stale remains
of a doughnut.  The system the monitors
were hooked up to has stopped working.
column3:
[title25][sentence]
桌上有一對螢幕、
一些文件，還有
風乾的甜甜圈殘骸。
螢幕連接的系統已經停擺。

column2:
[title26][sentence]
The rear wall is carved out of native rock, much
like the cell you just escaped from.  The walls
in the hallway show signs of damage from
the violent passage of your large friend.
column3:
[title26][sentence]
後牆是從原生岩石鑿出來的，
跟你剛逃出的牢房很像。
走廊牆上留著你那位
大個子朋友粗暴經過的痕跡。

column2:
[title30][sentence]
The thought that the same interior decorator
who chose 'early Mesozoic igneous' decor
for the back wall chose 'art deco' for these
lighting fixtures.  Falling objects pretty well
destroyed these fixtures.
column3:
[title30][sentence]
你心想，幫後牆選了
『中生代火成岩』風格的
室內設計師，大概也是
替這些燈具選了
『裝飾藝術』風。掉落的
雜物把它們砸壞了。

column2: [title19][sentence]\nThe panels of white lights keep this room\nextremely well lit.
column3: [title19][sentence]\n這片白光燈板\n把房間照得非常亮。

column2: [title22][sentence]\nYou don't have any need for forty feet of\nfluorescent light fixtures.
column3: [title22][sentence]\n你用不著\n十二公尺長的日光燈具。

column2:
[title26][sentence]
The little bulb dangling from a wire
in the middle of the room is dwarfed
by the light panels on either side.  This
must have been left here by the original
construction crew.
column3:
[title26][sentence]
房間中央用電線吊著的
那顆小燈泡，
在兩側大燈板的對比下
顯得特別渺小。
這應該是當初
施工隊留下來的。

column2: [title21][sentence]\nAttempting to steal this little light bulb\nwould accomplish little.
column3: [title21][sentence]\n想偷這顆小燈泡\n也不會有什麼收穫。

column2:
[title32][sentence]
Your pal pretty much killed everything that
inhabited the immediate area.  You don't need
to worry about any guards out there.
column3:
[title32][sentence]
你朋友幾乎把附近
所有活物都解決了，
不用擔心那邊還有警衛。

column2: [title16][sentence]\nYou don't see any signs of life in that direction.
column3: [title16][sentence]\n那個方向看不到任何生命跡象。

column2:
[title22][sentence]
The equipment in this room has been rendered
useless.  Your large friend did quite a good
job of trashing the place.
column3:
[title22][sentence]
這個房間裡的設備
全都報廢了，你那位
大個子朋友砸得很徹底。

column2:
[title26][sentence]
You pretty much destroyed the latch when
you kicked the grate open.  You shouldn't
have any trouble getting it open again.  Of
course the absence of any living guards
probably  means you don't need to crawl
around in air ducts any more.
column3:
[title26][sentence]
你當初一腳把柵門踢開時，
門閂差不多也毀了，
要再打開應該不成問題。
不過反正這裡
已經沒有活著的警衛，
你大概也不用
再爬通風管了。

column2: [title26][sentence]\nYou see some strange machinery in there.\nThat must be some kind of equipment room.
column3: [title26][sentence]\n你看到裡面有些\n奇怪的機械，那應該是某種設備室。

column2: [title26][sentence]\nConsidering what it did to you earlier, that\nmust be the infamous gender bender!
column3: [title26][sentence]\n想到它先前對你做的事，\n那一定就是惡名昭彰的錯體機！

column2: [title20][sentence]\nSince the latch is already broken,\nyou gently push open the grate.
column3: [title20][sentence]\n反正門閂已經壞了，\n你輕輕一推就把柵門打開。

column2:
[title33][sentence]
Your first kick serves only to
annoy your already-sore ankle.
Fortunately, your second kick destroys
the latch and the grate swings open.
column3:
[title33][sentence]
你第一腳只是讓
本來就很痛的腳踝
更火大而已。幸好
第二腳就踢壞了門閂，
柵門應聲彈開。

column2: [title19][sentence]\nThis was your cell for a while.  You do not\nmiss it at all.
column3: [title19][sentence]\n這裡曾經是你的\n牢房，你一點也不懷念。

column2:
[title27][sentence]
When you climbed in here you let
the air vent shut behind you, and the
latch closed again.  You give it a few
kicks, but the latch is too strong.
column3:
[title27][sentence]
你爬進來的時候
讓通風口在身後關上，
門閂又扣回去了。
你踢了幾腳，
但門閂太堅固了。

column2:
[title24][sentence]
This is your friend's cell.  He doesn't
look very happy sitting there.  You get the
distinct feeling he would be much happier
if he were ripping guards up and destroying
things.
column3:
[title24][sentence]
這是你朋友的牢房。
他坐在那裡，看起來
不太開心。你有種強烈的
預感，要是讓他去
撕警衛、砸東西，
他一定會開心得多。

column2: [title17][sentence]\nThis was your friend's cell before\nyou released him.
column3: [title17][sentence]\n這裡是你放他出來\n之前，你朋友待的牢房。

column2:
[title25][sentence]
You give the grate a couple good kicks,
but the latch on the other side is just
too strong.  You decide that you aren't
terribly interested in climbing into this
cell anyway.
column3:
[title25][sentence]
你朝柵門用力踢了
兩腳，但另一邊的
門閂太堅固了。
你決定反正自己
也沒多想爬進這間牢房。

column2:
[title32][sentence]
That horrible monster is in there
busily eating some unfortunate guard.
The sounds he is making in the process
are turning your stomach.
column3:
[title32][sentence]
那隻恐怖的怪物在裡面，
正忙著吃某個倒楣的警衛。
牠發出的聲音
讓你反胃。

column2:
[title25][sentence]
There are pieces of guard and monster
scattered all over the cell.  Something
shiny on the floor catches your eye, but
you can't make it out from here.
column3:
[title25][sentence]
牢房裡到處散落著
警衛跟怪物的碎塊。
地上有個閃亮的東西
吸引了你的目光，
但你從這裡看不清楚。

column2:
[title25][sentence]
There are pieces of guard and monster
scattered all over the cell.  It's truly
disgusting.
column3:
[title25][sentence]
牢房裡到處散落著
警衛跟怪物的碎塊，
實在噁心到不行。

column2:
[title26][sentence]
Briefly considering the fate
of the guard in that cell you decide
that you like having something
metallic between you and that
creature.
column3:
[title26][sentence]
稍微想了一下那間
牢房裡警衛的下場，
你決定還是喜歡
有個金屬柵欄
擋在你跟那隻怪物之間。

column2:
[title29][sentence]
You give the grate a couple kicks
and discover that it is stronger than
you are.
column3:
[title29][sentence]
你朝柵門踢了幾腳，
結果發現它
比你還硬。

column2: [title21][sentence]\nThere is nothing interesting about\nthis cell.  It is completely empty.
column3: [title21][sentence]\n這間牢房沒什麼\n特別的，完全是空的。

column2:
[title24][sentence]
You give the grate a couple kicks
but it does not give way.  In
frustration you kick it a few more
times, which serves only to hurt
your ankle.
column3:
[title24][sentence]
你朝柵門踢了幾腳，
但它紋風不動。
你不甘心又多踢了
幾下，結果只是
把自己的腳踝踢痛而已。
